SERVICE_HEADLINE: In, fitted, and back on the road
TAGLINE: New and used tires on Reseda Blvd, fitted quickly and priced plainly, open six days a week including all day Saturday.
SERVICES_INTRO: Tires, fitted while you wait, with the choice between new and good used stock explained rather than assumed.
SERVICE_1_BODY: Fitted, balanced and disposed of properly, with the old set gone before you leave.
SERVICE_2_BODY: A sensible option when the car does not warrant a new set, chosen on tread and age rather than whatever is nearest.
SERVICE_3_BODY: Punctures, rotation and balancing, which is the cheapest way to make a set last.
WHY_INTRO: There are other shops within a few minutes of here. This is what a customer actually notices.
WHY_1_BODY: The quote comes before the work, and nothing gets done without you agreeing to it.
WHY_2_BODY: A person picks up during opening hours, and a missed call gets returned the same day.
WHY_3_BODY: Whatever came off the car is there to look at if you want to see it.
CONTACT_INTRO: Call for anything urgent. For a quote or a booking the form reaches the desk directly.
